subject.title: [Feature]: 3 architecture improvements — bootstrap relevance, incremental compaction, observation extraction

question: Should this issue be narrowed to the unresolved core bootstrap-relevance work, with compaction delegated to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/58398 and observation extraction left to plugins?
rationale: The three proposals cross core prompt construction, session-state architecture, and an already-supported plugin boundary; automation cannot choose their permanent ownership or desired bootstrap selection semantics.

options.title: Split by owner boundary
options.body: Keep a focused bootstrap-relevance tracker, route compaction to the existing canonical issue, and document observation extraction as a plugin path.

options.title: Retain the umbrella
options.body: Keep all three proposals together and require maintainers to define separate milestones and acceptance criteria within this issue.

options.title: Decline core changes
options.body: Close the umbrella and rely on current bootstrap limits plus plugin surfaces, accepting that positional middle dropping remains unchanged.

recommendation.title: Split by owner boundary
recommendation.body: Keep a focused bootstrap-relevance tracker, route compaction to the existing canonical issue, and document observation extraction as a plugin path.

likelyOwner.reason: Already reviewed this exact issue and has recent history on the live bootstrap injection path.
